---
name: Design proposal / 設計提案
about: Discuss schema, architecture or consumer changes before implementation
---

## Problem and users / 誰の何を解決するか

## Proposed change and alternatives / 提案と代替案

## Public contract / 互換性

Affected IDs, schema/dataset versions, existing URLs, P2P/RPM adapters, migration and rollback.
No consumer is automatically migrated by accepting this issue.

## Evidence and validation / 根拠と検証

## Publication and operational risks / 公開・運用リスク

Dependencies, licenses, costs, permissions, private data and hosting changes.
